summary: Compositing and layers work improves how Firefox moves images, video frames, fences, and color information between processes and across platforms such as Android, macOS, and Wayland. It adds support for Android hardware buffers with WebGL, improves GPU synchronization and remote image color preservation, and updates WebRTC video orientation signaling so received video can be displayed correctly. Input and autoscroll messaging was also tightened, including DPI-aware autoscroll, making scrolling and cross-process rendering more dependable.
